questions.stem: What is the function of the Golgi apparatus?

options.text: It modifies, packages, and distributes proteins made by the cell
It synthesises proteins from amino acids
It carries out aerobic respiration to produce ATP
It stores DNA and controls gene expression

questions.explanation: The Golgi apparatus receives proteins from the endoplasmic reticulum and modifies, packages, and distributes them to where they are needed, including for secretion outside the cell.
